notes.title: Price change and a small word from the developer.
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I would like to announce that VRtender will now be $0.99. 

This decision comes from a couple of factors that I'd like to share with you.

VRtender was my first foray into video game development. I learned a lot during it's creation and enjoyed making it every step of the way. There are a lot of things that I wanted to do with this game that time and experience, at the time, didn't allow. I learned that finishing a project is, in and of itself, it's own skill. 

Since the release of VRtender, I have continued my journey in game development and have learned a lot more and made much progress. I feel like I've "leveled up" so to speak. I now look at VRtender as a testament to my skill and determination at the time. One I'd like to share with anyone who wants to play it. 

So now, I'd like to thank everyone who bought this game at the full release price. I'd like to thank anyone and everyone who's given feedback, good or bad. You all inspire me to push forward and keep chasing the dream.

Many thanks and happy bartending,
Brandon and the Further Beyond Team.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - Bug Fixes and Steam Cloud Support
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug preventing the "Beer Is For Breakfast" achievement from unlocking.

-Fixed a bug preventing the Arcade Mode option from appearing in the main menu after being unlocked.

-Added Steam Cloud support.
